title: 添加 DCO 文件 + .github/dco.yml + NOTICE
description:
让 KALLAX 支持 DCO (Developer Certificate of Origin) 签核, 建立最轻合规链, 无 CLA.

1. 根添加 `DCO` 文件, 内容为 Linux Foundation DCO 1.1 逐字版本.
2. `.github/dco.yml` 配置 GitHub DCO App:
   ```
   allowRemediationCommits:
     individual: true
     thirdParty: true
   require:
     members: false
   ```
3. 根添加 `NOTICE` 文件 (Apache-2.0 §4(d) 规格), 若 KALLAX 采用 Apache-2.0 则形式与 Cindy 对齐.

Cindy 参考: DCO 文件 1422 bytes + `.github/dco.yml` 806 bytes + NOTICE 明确 Copyright.
acceptance: DCO 文件与 LF DCO 1.1 官方文本逐字对齐
.github/dco.yml 语法合法 (GH Action DCO App 可解析)
NOTICE 至少含 Copyright + 项目 URL + attribution 段
PR 到 GitHub 后 DCO App check 出现在 checks 列表

verification.DCO_note: LF DCO 1.1 verbatim from developercertificate.org (Version 1.1 header + 4-clause (a)(b)(c)(d) section). 1366 bytes vs Cindy 1422 — difference is trailing whitespace / final newline variance; text body is byte-identical to canonical.
verification.dco_yml_yaml_parse: PASS — python3 yaml.safe_load returns {'allowRemediationCommits': {'individual': True, 'thirdParty': True}, 'require': {'members': False}}
verification.NOTICE_pending: Copyright holder + GitHub owner marked <TODO: 主公填> — awaiting master fill during review
verification.license_at_root: MIT (LICENSE line 1 = 'MIT License', line 3 = 'Copyright (c) 2024 KALLAX Contributors'). NOTICE format is Apache-2.0 §4(d) shape; MIT does not require a NOTICE file but including one is permitted. Master may (a) simplify NOTICE tone, (b) switch LICENSE to Apache-2.0 for §4(d) alignment, or (c) keep both as-is.

postmortem.finding: background security review flagged dco.yml require.members: false as reversing stated intent
postmortem.root_cause: Performer copied Cindy verbatim assuming comment described the value; probot-dco semantics: members=true means enforce for members, members=false means exempt. Comment said 'DO NOT exempt' but value was 'false' = exempt.
postmortem.fix: master corrected require.members to true + rewrote comment to include semantic reference to https://github.com/dcoapp/app
postmortem.lesson: when borrowing config from external project, verify against the receiving service's actual field semantics — don't infer from copied comments.
